decisions.reason: The candidate already covers adding the integrated board to JLCPCB; extending orientation validation to that board does not change the order-configuration requirement.
Verifying component orientation does not alter the required through-hole connector mounting technology.
Component-orientation validation does not change BOM part-number or board-specific BOM requirements.
The orientation check does not change the lead-free manufacturing constraint.
The source decision concerns placement orientation, not component availability, alternatives, or procurement policy.
Verifying assembly orientation does not change the QR marking requirement or its board coverage.
The source decision does not add, remove, or alter any required production export file.
Component-orientation validation does not alter connector pin labeling or marking location.
The source adds a manufacturing validation activity for the integrated board but does not change any physical-layout or connector-placement constraint.
The orientation check does not change breakout pin coverage, format, placement, purpose, or pitch.
The source does not resolve or modify antenna placement, keepout, direction, or the existing secondary-clear-area ambiguity.
Applying orientation validation to the integrated board does not change the existence, composition, or functionality of either PCB architecture variant.
